note: 3D grass near the camera (D-115). Placement: tools/map_import/build_grass_masks.tscn writes one density mask per cell (mask_m metres per pixel, 0..255) from the baked cells - roads get a little (weeds through cracks), their edges more, sidewalks a little, buildings / water / greens / bunkers / tees / cart paths none, fairways some; run it after every build_cells. Runtime (GrassField): chunks of chunk_m around the camera out to the tier's radius_m, density = clumps per square metre at full mask, each clump dropped onto the Terrain collider with a ray (anything else under it - a building, a landmark floor, a car - means no grass). The last fade_share of the radius shrinks the blades to nothing, so there is no pop. Low tier draws none.
